ValidationRule.description: Upon approval, require that Max Term, Approval Date, Credit Tier, Approved Amount fields are populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Credit_Decision__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Credit_Decision__c, "Manager Review")), OR( ISPICKVAL(Credit_Tier__c, ""), DATEVALUE(Approval_Date__c)= NULL, Approved_Amount__c = NULL , ISPICKVAL(Max_Term__c, ""), ISPICKVAL( Titling_Attachment_Required__c , ""), ISPICKVAL(EFA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(FMV__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Dollar_Put__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Titling_Attachment_Required__c, "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An approval or manager review requires that the following fields contains values: Max Term, Approval Date, Credit Tier, Approved Amount, Titling Required and Buyout Tax Treatments.
